issues.title: Exact bitmap BF through CM compress offset
issues.hypothesis: E0006 records JoinFilterPushdownColumn::storage_offset when the probe key passes through __internal_compress_integral_*(x, off). Only offset-shifted min/max and range-set filters are pushed. The BF is explicitly skipped (physical_hash_join.cpp:1059 requires storage_offset.IsNull() and !has_cast). As a result the q09 orders scan still reads all 15M rows into the o_orderkey HJ. A previous run on the same workload pushed the EXACT bitmap BF through the offset: orders scan 15M→2.94M rows, q09 -14.3%. The hashed-BF version was +4.7%, so only the exact mode is worth porting. E0007 has since landed the exact bitmap (BloomFilter::SetExactRange/LookupExact), so the remaining piece is a probe-side shift.
issues.plan: 1) In bloom_filter.hpp BFTableFilter, add a uint64_t key_offset (wrapping add, default 0). It applies only in exact mode: the probe computes LookupExact(widen(stored_value) - offset_as_u64), with signed or unsigned widening based on the scanned (storage) column type, not the HT key type. Apply the same shift in FilterValue and CheckStatistics, which shifts the zonemap min/max with overflow checks; if unsure, return NO_PRUNING_POSSIBLE. Include it in Equals/Copy/ToString/serialization if those exist. 2) In physical_hash_join.cpp FinalizeFilters (~l.1057-1067), add a second branch: when storage_offset is not NULL, ht, key 0, CanUseBloomFilter, and the exact gate (TrySetExactBloomFilter) succeeds, defer the push and pass the offset. The compressed key type (condition type) differs from storage_type, so allow has_cast in this branch only, because the scan column is the original integer column. In PushBloomFilter (deferred path), only push if bf->IsExact() && !ExactOverflow() and set key_offset; otherwise push nothing (never hashed BF through an offset). The exact gate must be decided before Finalize fills the bitmap; if it fails, don't build the BF. 3) Verify on TEMP tables against SET disabled_optimizers='join_filter_pushdown': a BIGINT key with a non-zero min (e.g. 1e9+k), negative keys, an aggregate between scan and join so CM fires, and a sparse build (~10%) so the selectivity wrapper keeps the filter; check in EXPLAIN ANALYZE that the probe scan row count drops.
issues.expected_gain: q09 -10..-14% (prior -14.3%); possibly q05/q07/q08/q18 a few % wherever CM sits between scan and join.
issues.generality: Any join on dense integer keys whose probe key passes through compressed materialization (aggregates or sorts between scan and join), which is common in star/FK joins. Little regression risk: the SelectivityOptionalFilter wrapper disables it when it is unselective.
issues.risk: Medium. A wrong offset sign or widening silently drops rows (wrong results). Mitigate with the offset-shifted key tests above. CheckStatistics shifting must not over-prune.

dispatch: Exact bitmap BF through CM compress offset
output.memory:
## Memory (gen1)

## State
- r1: E0001 JoinDependentFilterRule before DistributivityRule ACCEPTED: q19 -46%, geomean -4.2%.
- r2: E0002 contains()/LIKE length-aware selectivity ACCEPTED: q09 -37%, geomean -3.9%.
- r3: E0003 Perfect HJ RIGHT v2 ACCEPTED: q13 -18..-20%. Large range (up to 4M) is allowed only for RIGHT joins; for INNER it regressed q14 +52% and q18 +13% (serial perfect build, no BF).
- r4: E0004 substring prefilter (ColumnData::Filter) RETIRED. q13 -7.7% (needed -13.8%). A good idea that fell short of the bar; retry it bundled with FSST batched decode or the follow-ups.
- r5: E0005 BF on first key of multi-key HJ ACCEPTED: q09 -18..-22%.
- r6: E0006 join key-set range filter through compress projs ACCEPTED: q18 -6..-9%. Added JoinFilterPushdownColumn::storage_offset (a Value; NULL = no offset), JoinFilterValueToStorage, and PushRangeSetFilter.
- r7: E0007 exact key-bitmap BF ACCEPTED: q03 -18%, q04 -20%, q09 -12%, q16 -6%, geomean -4.7%. Best 1.178x.
- r8 DISPATCHED: exact bitmap BF through the CM offset (prior q09 -14.3%). Adds BFTableFilter key_offset; the push in physical_hash_join.cpp FinalizeFilters ~l.1059 is currently gated on storage_offset.IsNull() && !has_cast.
- Claude auto-memory (~/.claude/.../memory) holds results from a PREVIOUS evolve run on this same codebase/workload. Treat them as strong measured priors, not as already-landed code.
- .dbe/issues.md backlog is stale: its 3 issues are all landed (E0002, E0003, E0006).

## Prior-run wins to port, in rough priority order (gain / risk)
1-6. DONE (rule reorder, contains selectivity, perfect HJ RIGHT, BF first key, q18 key-set range, exact bitmap BF).
7. r8: exact BF through the CM offset.
8. Semi-join RHS-aware estimate + HAVING 0.2 selectivity (q18 -8%). Needs both CardinalityEstimator::CalculateUpdatedDenom SEMI and the relation_manager change.
9. Large perfect HA (22-bit) + parallel source: q13 -18.6%. Distinct HT partitioned on group hash: q16 -12%.
10. OR-of-ranges as ExpressionFilter, dense mask eval: q19 -7..-11%.
11. FSST batched decode (q13 -4..-7%), possibly combined with the substring prefilter retry.
12. E0007 follow-ups: exact BF for IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (track NULL inserted); parallel perfect HJ build, or keep the BF alongside it (would unlock large-range INNER perfect HJ).
- q04/q03 improved via E0007; re-profile them after the ports run out.

## Known dead ends (prior run)
- HJ prefetch, agg run-collapse, in-place finalize, FSST heap reuse, dictionary filter, scan filter cost ordering, early HT grow, sparse perfect HJ, bitpacking select, BF on sparse perfect HJ, hashed BF through CM offset: all ~0% or worse.

## Codebase facts
- Rule registration order lives in src/optimizer/optimizer.cpp.
- Scan-filter cardinality: RelationStatisticsHelper::InspectTableFilter (relation_statistics_helper.cpp).
- ColumnData::Filter = Scan + ColumnSegment::FilterSelection. enable_fsst_vectors defaults to false.
- Perfect HJ gates: perfect_hash_join_executor.cpp CanDoPerfectHashJoin; join_filter_pushdown_optimizer.cpp computes min/max aggregates.
- BF pushdown: physical_hash_join.cpp JoinFilterPushdownInfo::FinalizeFilters (~l.1057, deferred_bloom_filters) → PushBloomFilter. TrySetExactBloomFilter (~l.896) picks exact mode before the fill. Exact fill is in JoinHashTable::Finalize. BloomFilter exact API: SetExactRange/InsertExact/LookupExact/ExactOverflow in planner/filter/bloom_filter.hpp.
- JoinFilterPushdownColumn is in include/duckdb/execution/operator/join/join_filter_pushdown.hpp. CM functions are in src/function/scalar/compressed_materialization/compress_integral.cpp.
- CM runs in STATISTICS_PROPAGATION, after TopN/RowGroupPruner. Those also call GetPushdownFilterTargets, so they must reject columns with an offset (done in E0006).
- OptionalFilter is evaluated only once per row group or segment (zonemap). The SelectivityOptionalFilter switches the filter off when about 30% of rows pass; test the BF with a sparse (~10%) build.
- Noise: q04/q08/q17 swing ±5-15%; q13 needs about -14% to count. Single-template gains under ~10% tend to get retired.
- Testing NOT LIKE pushdown: compare against s||''. Testing BF: compare against SET disabled_optimizers='join_filter_pushdown' on TEMP tables.
- Budget is tight (~$4/session): read memory/ledger, then dispatch the next prior win quickly.
